_meta.description: Segment customers.pulse into three clusters by age and income with GROUP_KMEANS: seeded k-means++ starts then Lloyd on z-scored members, keys cluster_1..cluster_3 by descending size (key column GROUP_KMEANS_age). Each cluster reports its size and mean age and income; Components carry the centroids, within-SS and the between-SS ratio. Same data and seed always give the same labels.
_meta.name: group_kmeans
